summary: Backend-only regression for Phase 1 admin panel repair sprint (iter 154). Verified the critical security fix (25 admin endpoints previously rejected charbel911@gmail.com with 403 due to email.endswith('@bidvex.com') — now use role-based admin check) and the new /api/admin/vehicle-deposits router. 21/21 pytest tests PASSED. No regressions detected.
what_was_tested: PUT /api/admin/site-mode with full bilingual + scheduled payload — 200 {success:true} (was 403 pre-fix)
POST /api/escrow/admin/charge-penalty — NOT 403 (role gate passes; Stripe downstream skipped per scope)
localhost:8001/openapi.json paths include all 4 new /api/admin/vehicle-deposits routes
critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin_deposits.py status-gate allows release/capture only when deposit.status in ('paid','authorized') — good. However PaymentService.process_deposit_refund / capture_deposit are NOT idempotent by test; recommend main agent verify double-click protection persists status transition before Stripe call to avoid race (frontend actionBusy helps but server should enforce).

routes/site_mode.py update_site_mode persists scheduled_start/scheduled_end but GET /api/site-mode (public) does NOT echo message_fr / scheduled_start / scheduled_end. If the coming-soon / maintenance page needs them, update the public GET response shape (currently returns mode, message, expected_back, social_links only).
routes/admin.py update_user_status: performs db.users.update_one keyed on 'id' — confirm user schema uses 'id' not '_id' elsewhere; consistent with rest of codebase based on tests passing.

openapi.json is only reachable via localhost (ingress strips non-/api paths) — fine for internal inspection, but /api/openapi.json is 404. If main agent wants admin-facing API docs, either mount openapi under /api or expose /api/docs explicitly.
seed_data_creation: None. test_update_user_status_happy_path toggles an existing non-admin user's status to suspended then restores to active (idempotent cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 154 backend-only. All Phase-1 admin security fixes verified. When frontend UI testing is needed, focus on: AdminEscrowManager Vehicle Deposits tab (release/capture confirm modals), SiteModeManager (FR message + schedule fields), TrustSafetyDashboard ban/suspend/restore buttons, VehicleAdminManager double-click protection. The admin login token from POST /api/auth/login uses 'access_token' key (fixture handles both 'access_token' and 'token').
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. All 25 formerly-broken admin endpoints now accept charbel911@gmail.com. New /api/admin/vehicle-deposits routes behave correctly: 404 on missing ids, 401/403 without auth, 200 with proper shape for admin.
